description: Seed golden set for Copilot eval harness. Replace with your full real question list. These 3 questions exist to prove the runner works end-to-end and to lock Bug A/B/D fixes as regression guards.

questions.question: How many gummy hashables do we have?
questions.notes: Bug B regression guard. Prior behavior: search_packages returned one package showing 18,040 and the Copilot reported that as the total. Correct behavior: answer uses aggregated total across ALL matching packages, either via get_inventory_overview or via search_packages.aggregatedQuantityByItem. Must NOT report a single package quantity as the total.

questions.question: How many total packages do we have?
questions.notes: Bug D regression guard. Copilot total must match dashboard inventory total ±1%. Tests the service-layer single-source-of-truth principle.

questions.question: What's our FIFO violation count?
questions.notes: Compliance accuracy check. Previous sprint fixed briefing/alerts divergence — this test locks that in.
